meta.headline: There is no recorded wall time, agent count or round count for the offline conversion of any engine. Everything under derived_from_git is my derivation, not a logged fact.
meta.fact_vs_derivation: `recorded_facts` and `upstream_patches.ledger` quote the repo. `derived_from_git` is computed by me; the method is in `how`.

whole_repo.source: git log origin/main; gh pr list

caution: Main is squash-merged and several PR batches were merged minutes apart, so commit dates bound the calendar window (7 days for the whole repo) but not the effort.
The measurements inside the Megatron and FastVideo PRs are dated 2026-11-07, one to two days before those PRs merged.
vLLM had a long prototype phase before this repo's history starts (docs/lessons.md:10-18); its duration is not recorded here.

recorded_facts.fact: The first prototype was about 45k lines with 245 run records and 51 hand repairs; the v1 redesign is about 7.7k lines of code plus 4.4k of tests.
On the same 19 upstream PRs, v1 needed a full restart on 0 (prototype: 2) and went live in place on 8 (prototype: 6).
The orchestrator prompt says the prototype replayed 53 real upstream PRs live before v1.
The first v1 replay on GPUs found 4 bugs the CPU toy could not show; fixed in PRs #52-#55.

Dates: first and last author date of those commits. Lines added/deleted: sum of `git log --numstat -- repos/<engine>`. Current size: line count of every tracked file under the folder at origin/main.

upstream_patches.note: repos/vllm has no patches/ folder. PR descriptions state the lab runs against unmodified vLLM (0.15.1 in PRs #136/#137, a 0.33.0 fork in #135). The lab hooks in at run time: a worker extension class, a sitecustomize module and an engine-core patch applied at import.

notes: The added/deleted totals are inflated: the shared kernel was first built under repos/vllm (PRs #18-#32), then moved to template/ (#107) and core/ (#122). The kernel now lives in core/livelab (39 files, 12,673 lines; kernel alone 27 files, 10,183 lines).
The 7,848 non-test lines under repos/vllm/livelab are close to, but not the same count as, the 'about 7.7k lines' in docs/lessons.md, which was written before later services were added.

recorded_facts.fact: All Megatron lab measurements are dated 2026-11-07; the lab PRs #72-#88 merged within about 25 minutes on 2026-11-09 UTC, so merge times do not show how long the work took.
Hill-climb on the finished lab (not the conversion): 82 iterations 00:55-06:23 PST, 206 iterations by 12:05 PST, Qwen3-14B architecture, TP 2 on 2 GB200.
Conformance c0-c10 passed 11/11 on a real 2-rank Megatron job (tiny model).
